PRIVACY POLICY

Your room stays yours.

Playfield has no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Hands are tracked on your iPhone and playing a game sends nothing off it. The AI game builder needs an account and sends your requests to AI providers, only after you allow it.

Last updated 31 October 2026. Applies to the Playfield iOS app and projectplayfield.com.

Who we areOn your iPhoneYour accountThe AI game builderSafety and ageOther servicesChildrenYour choices and deleting data

Who we are

Playfield is made by Abdul Rashid, an individual developer. Contact: abdulrreshamwala@gmail.com. We never sell data.

On your iPhone

The camera is used on the phone to track hands. Camera images are not uploaded when you play. Your games, settings and age check result are stored on the phone, and games are not shared with other users. Voice prompts are turned into text by Apple’s speech recognition, on the phone where supported, otherwise by Apple.

Your account

Playing needs no account. The game builder needs Sign in with Apple. Apple shares an account identifier and, if you allow it, your name and email (or a private relay address). Playfield stores them with Firebase Authentication (Google) to run your account and answer support requests.

The AI game builder

The builder runs on servers, not on your phone. Nothing is sent until you allow it. Once you do, the app sends your requests (typed, or speech as text), the game’s code and files, pictures of the game as drawn for the projector (these can show hand outlines), and art descriptions to Playfield’s server (api.projectplayfield.com). The server passes them to OpenRouter and the company that runs the AI model, under their own terms, with your account ID so usage can be counted. Playfield asks for providers that do not store prompts or train on them.

If “Let the builder see the camera” is on (you choose when you allow the builder), it can also send photos of the play area. Playfield’s server does not keep your requests or the builder’s replies. It keeps a usage total under your account ID for your monthly allowance.

Safety and age

Requests are checked by a content filter before the builder sees them. The builder is for people aged 13 and over: Apple’s age check tells Playfield only whether you are 13 or older, and the result stays on your phone. If you report builder content with the flag button, the report (your account ID, the content, your note and a small picture) is sent to and stored on our server so we can review it.

Other services

Apple (sign-in, age check, speech), Google Firebase (sign-in), Cloudflare (hosting), OpenRouter and model providers (the builder), and, for search words only, Openverse, Polyfork and, if you add a key, Poly Pizza. Each handles data under its own privacy policy. This website has no cookies or trackers.

Children

Playing is open to everyone and sends nothing off the phone. The builder is for people 13 and over. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13; if you think we have, email us and we will delete it.

Your choices and deleting data

  • Turn off the builder’s use of AI providers, or its camera access, any time in Settings › Privacy.
  • Delete your account in Settings › Account › Delete account. This deletes your sign-in details. Your games stay on your phone until you delete them.
  • To delete your usage total and any reports linked to your account, or for any other privacy request, email abdulrreshamwala@gmail.com.

If we change what the app sends, we will update this page and ask for your permission again.
